lines: <pulse>Back</pulse> to the drying racks before the hides get ahead of me.
I should return to the seams while the leather still has some give.
A few cuts need reinforcing before the client comes back.
I have wax to work in and buckles to test.
<pulse>Back</pulse> to smoothing grain and trimming edges.
I promised a set of straps by this afternoon, and they are not done yet.
The next hide is ready for scraping. I had better not leave it waiting.
I need daylight to match these dyes, so I should get moving.
There is a saddle on my bench with half its stitching pulled out.
I left a pair of boots under weight. Time to see whether they kept their shape.
Enough rest. The cauldron will not mind itself.
I should wash the salt from my tools before it dries on them.
A customer wants that belt before supper. I still need to punch the holes.
If I stay here, the wet hides will start smelling worse than usual.
I need both hands for the next cut. We can talk later.
The edge dye should be dry by now. I want to check it before dust settles.
I have enjoyed the company, but my workbench is still full.
The straps soaking by the cauldron need turning.
Come by again after I finish fitting those boots.
I have kept the tannery waiting long enough.
